论文针对肺 CT 和合成 X 光重建；文本条件不是免费获得的信息。
The paper studies lung CT with simulated X-rays. Report conditioning must be declared.
本条为 source_route：已核原始源码和根许可证；未执行原模型、未验证临床效果。
Source route only: official source and root license checked; original inference and clinical performance were not tested here.
在公开医学图文对上微调 Stable Diffusion 1.4 的条件去噪 U-Net，冻结文本编码器与 VAE，用同一个潜扩散模型根据文本生成跨专科二维医学图像。

MediSyn fine-tunes the conditional denoising U-Net of Stable Diffusion 1.4 on public medical image–text pairs while freezing the text encoder and VAE, using one latent diffusion model for text-guided 2D medical image synthesis across specialties.
生成时输入描述模态、解剖部位或疾病的文本提示与随机高斯潜变量，去噪器还接收扩散时间步；训练时使用医学图像与由模态信息、既有类别标签组成的配对文本。

Generation takes a text prompt describing modality, anatomy or disease, together with a Gaussian latent sample; the denoiser also receives the diffusion timestep. Training uses medical images paired with captions assembled from modality information and existing class labels.
与文本提示条件对应的二维合成医学图像；作者演示采用512×512像素输出。
A synthetic 2D medical image conditioned on the text prompt, with 512×512 output in the author demonstration.
医学图像—文本对
Medical image–text pairs
汇集六个专科、十种成像模态。将已有类别标签与模态信息写成文本；尽可能先按患者划分训练、验证与测试数据，再进入生成模型训练。

Six specialties and ten imaging modalities supply paired examples. Captions describe existing class labels and modality information; patient-level splitting is used wherever possible before model training.
冻结 VAE 编码器
Frozen VAE encoder
训练阶段把真实图像编码为较小的空间潜表示。这个编码器保持冻结，图像压缩不是本次医学微调的主要学习位置。
During training, a frozen VAE encoder maps real images to a smaller spatial latent representation. The image compressor is retained rather than being the main target of medical fine-tuning.
冻结 CLIP 文本编码器
Frozen CLIP text encoder
从 CLIP ViT-L 取出的文本编码器把提示转成条件表示。发布配置的交叉注意力条件维度为768；最终选定的 MediSyn 配置不更新该编码器。
A text encoder taken from CLIP ViT-L embeds the prompt. The released configuration uses a cross-attention condition dimension of 768, and the selected MediSyn configuration keeps this encoder frozen.
潜空间加噪与时间步
Latent corruption and timestep
向训练图像的潜表示加入高斯噪声；带噪潜变量与时间步共同定义当前去噪问题。生成时从随机高斯潜变量开始，而不是先输入某位患者的图像。
Gaussian noise corrupts an encoded training image. The noisy latent and timestep define the denoising problem; generation instead starts from a Gaussian latent sample rather than a patient image.
医学微调条件 U-Net
Medical fine-tuning of the conditional U-Net
U-Net 预测噪声，文本通过中间层交叉注意力参与计算。固定发布配置使用4通道潜输入/输出、64的样本空间尺寸、每块2层，以及320、640、1280、1280的块通道宽度。

The U-Net predicts noise, with text entering through intermediate cross-attention. The pinned release configuration specifies four input/output latent channels, sample size 64, two layers per block and block widths of 320, 640, 1280 and 1280.
噪声预测均方误差
Noise-prediction MSE
将预测噪声与实际加入的噪声比较，以均方误差更新 U-Net。训练中10%的提示被替换为空文本，为推理时的无分类器引导提供无条件分支。

Mean squared error compares predicted noise with the noise actually added, updating the U-Net. Ten percent of training prompts are replaced with empty text to support classifier-free guidance at inference.
文本引导的迭代采样
Text-guided iterative sampling
复用已训练 U-Net，在逐步变化的时间步上去噪潜变量。作者演示将其装入 Stable Diffusion 1.4 管线，采用空负提示与7.0的引导尺度；这些是演示配置，不是所有任务的最优值。

The trained U-Net repeatedly denoises the latent over successive timesteps. The author demo inserts it into a Stable Diffusion 1.4 pipeline and uses an empty negative prompt with guidance scale 7.0; these are demo settings rather than universal optima.
冻结 VAE 解码器
Frozen VAE decoder
将最后的去噪潜表示映射回像素空间。VAE 解码器在图像合成阶段使用，仍保留基础模型的预训练参数。
The frozen VAE decoder maps the final denoised latent back to pixels, retaining the base model's pretrained parameters during image synthesis.
合成图像与下游评估
Synthetic image and downstream evaluation
输出二维医学图像，分别评估视觉分布、图文对应和下游分类用途。图像逼真度、生成多样性与对真实数据训练的帮助是不同的评价问题。

The output is a 2D medical image. Distributional appearance, text alignment and downstream classifier utility are assessed separately; fidelity, diversity and usefulness for learning from real data are different evaluation questions.
为每个专科、模态和部位维护独立生成模型，增加训练、部署与反复加载权重的成本；依赖私有训练数据也不便复现。MediSyn 研究能否让一个模型学习多种医学图像分布。

Maintaining a generator for every specialty, modality and anatomical region adds training, deployment and repeated model-loading costs, while private training data limits reproducibility. MediSyn asks whether one model can learn diverse medical image distributions.
保留 Stable Diffusion 1.4 的潜扩散框架，在统一的医学图文数据上只微调 U-Net。VAE 负责像素与潜表示之间的映射，冻结的文本编码器提供提示条件。

Retain the latent diffusion framework of Stable Diffusion 1.4 and fine-tune only its U-Net on a unified medical image–text collection. The VAE maps between pixels and latents, while a frozen text encoder supplies prompt conditions.
通用性来自跨专科数据与训练设计，而非更换一套全新主干。作者比较六种基础模型及微调配置后，选定冻结 VAE 和文本编码器、仅更新 U-Net 的 SD1.4 配置作为 MediSyn。

Generality comes from the cross-specialty data and training design rather than a completely new backbone. After comparing six model/training configurations, the authors select SD1.4 with a frozen VAE and text encoder and a fine-tuned U-Net as MediSyn.
用已有模态信息和类别标签构建提示，覆盖胃肠、放射、病理、外科、皮肤与眼科。用途是可控合成与低数据条件下的数据增强，学习目标仍是生成图像。

Prompts use existing modality information and class labels across gastroenterology, radiology, pathology, surgery, dermatology and ophthalmology. The aim is controlled synthesis and augmentation in limited-data settings, with image generation remaining the learning objective.
原文显示图像保真度与多样性存在取舍，下游受益也因类别和数据量而异。已见过的模态与部位不能任意组合为新任务；新疾病提示可能产生不准确图像，且论文未给出形式化隐私保证。

The paper reports tradeoffs between fidelity and diversity, with downstream gains varying by class and data regime. Familiar modalities and anatomy do not combine arbitrarily into unseen tasks; novel disease prompts may be inaccurate, and no formal privacy guarantee is established.
潜空间承担扩散计算，像素空间主要由 VAE 处理。训练时编码真实图像并加入噪声；生成时从高斯潜变量开始，二者共享条件噪声预测器。

Diffusion operates in latent space while the VAE handles the pixel representation. Training encodes and corrupts real images; generation starts with Gaussian latents, sharing the same conditional noise predictor.
文本不是最终图像的标签预测结果，而是控制生成分布的条件。交叉注意力让 U-Net 的中间特征利用提示中的模态与医学语义。

Text is a condition on the generated distribution rather than a diagnostic label predicted from the output. Cross-attention lets intermediate U-Net features use modality and medical semantics from the prompt.
最终发布路线只微调 U-Net；VAE 与 CLIP ViT-L 文本编码器保持冻结。论文还比较 SDXL 和 BiomedCLIP 文本编码器变体，不能把所有变体都称为已发布的 MediSyn 配置。

The selected release fine-tunes only the U-Net while freezing the VAE and CLIP ViT-L text encoder. SDXL and BiomedCLIP text-encoder configurations are also compared in the paper and should not all be presented as the released MediSyn configuration.
第4.2节描述的训练设计为15个epoch、有效批量128、SD学习率5×10⁻⁵、Bfloat16计算与10%空提示。损失比较预测噪声和加入噪声，生成图像并不需要逐像素配对的目标图像。

Section 4.2 specifies 15 epochs, effective batch size 128, SD learning rate 5×10⁻⁵, Bfloat16 computation and 10% empty prompts. The objective compares predicted and added noise; generation does not require a paired target image at inference.
研究使用1,260,826个图文对，其中训练1,014,781、验证122,463、测试123,582；尽可能按患者约80∶10∶10划分。公开可获取不等于每个源数据集都允许任意再分发，数据仍保留各自使用条件。

The study curates 1,260,826 pairs, comprising 1,014,781 training, 122,463 validation and 123,582 test pairs, using approximately 80∶10∶10 patient-level splits wherever possible. Public availability does not give every source dataset unrestricted redistribution rights.
本条的机制和原图对应 arXiv v7（2026-04-21），首次预印本公开于2024-05-16；期刊论文于2026-10-16发表。作者公开的是 U-Net 权重、配置与推理演示，本条不把它描述为完整公开训练工程。

The mechanism and original figure here follow arXiv v7, dated 2026-04-21. The first preprint appeared on 2024-05-16 and the journal article on 2026-10-16. The authors release a U-Net, configuration and inference demonstration; this is not described here as a complete published training project.
覆盖六个专科和十种成像模态：CT、X光、MRI、超声、内镜、显微、眼底、OCT、皮肤镜与临床照片。研究的是二维图像合成，不应据此推定完整三维体数据或任何未列出的模态。

The six specialties span ten modalities: CT, X-ray, MRI, ultrasound, endoscopy, microscopy, fundoscopy, OCT, dermoscopy and clinical photography. The work studies 2D synthesis rather than establishing full 3D volume generation or support for unlisted modalities.
论文用多种评估分别检查合成质量、加载与推理成本、医生对视觉真实性及图文对应的判断、训练图像近邻差异，以及低数据条件下的分类增强。每种评估回答的问题不同。

Separate evaluations examine synthetic quality, loading/inference cost, physician judgments of realism and text alignment, differences from training-image neighbors, and classifier augmentation with limited real data. These evaluations answer different questions.
对皮肤镜和机器人辅助前列腺切除图像，MediSyn 的 FID 更低但 MS-SSIM 更高；肌骨X光方向相反。不能把“跨专科”简化为所有任务的保真度与多样性都同时改善。

In dermoscopy and robot-assisted prostatectomy images, MediSyn has lower FID but higher MS-SSIM than the task-specific counterpart; musculoskeletal X-rays show the reverse pattern. Cross-specialty training does not imply simultaneous fidelity and diversity improvements for every task.
论文给出的失败例包括：虽见过MRI和胸部X光，仍不能据此生成可靠的胸部MRI；此前未见过的疾病描述也可能得到医学上不准确的图像。

The paper gives a concrete failure example: seeing MRI and chest X-rays does not enable reliable chest MRI generation. Previously unseen disease descriptions can also yield medically inaccurate images.
合成图像与训练近邻不同，不等于形式化隐私保证。训练模态不平衡、类别间差异与临床准确性仍需在所需用途上分别验证。
Differences from nearest training images do not establish a formal privacy guarantee. Modality imbalance, class-dependent behavior and clinical accuracy still require evaluation for the intended use.
基础架构
Architecture
MediSyn 采用 Stable Diffusion 1.4 的 VAE、CLIP ViT-L 文本编码器与交叉注意力 U-Net；最终配置只微调 U-Net。
MediSyn uses the VAE, CLIP ViT-L text encoder and cross-attention U-Net of Stable Diffusion 1.4; only the U-Net is fine-tuned in the selected configuration.
数据范围
Data coverage
第4.1节报告六个专科、十种模态及1,260,826个图文对，并列明训练、验证、测试规模与尽可能采用的患者级划分。
Section 4.1 reports six specialties, ten modalities and 1,260,826 image–text pairs, specifying train/validation/test sizes and patient-level splitting wherever possible.
训练设计
Training design
训练以噪声预测均方误差更新 U-Net，使用10%空提示支持无分类器引导；论文比较六种基础模型及微调配置。
Training updates the U-Net with noise-prediction MSE and uses 10% empty prompts for classifier-free guidance; the paper compares six base-model and fine-tuning configurations.
固定发布配置
Pinned release configuration
固定 Hugging Face 提交中的配置类为 UNet2DConditionModel，潜输入/输出均4通道、sample_size为64、cross_attention_dim为768。
The pinned Hugging Face configuration is a UNet2DConditionModel with four latent input/output channels, sample_size 64 and cross_attention_dim 768.
作者推理演示
Author inference demonstration
作者笔记本将已发布 U-Net 装入 CompVis/stable-diffusion-v1-4 管线，生成512×512图像；示例引导尺度为7.0。
The author notebook inserts the released U-Net into the CompVis/stable-diffusion-v1-4 pipeline and generates 512×512 images with example guidance scale 7.0.
保真度与多样性
Fidelity and diversity
第2.1节报告的相对 FID 与 MS-SSIM 方向随模态不同，不能据此断言所有任务上的质量指标都同时改善。
Section 2.1 reports modality-dependent relative FID and MS-SSIM behavior rather than simultaneous improvement of every quality measure across all tasks.
泛化与隐私范围
Generalization and privacy scope
讨论部分指出未见过的模态—部位组合和疾病提示可能失败，训练数据不平衡，且尚无形式化隐私保证。
The discussion identifies failures on unseen modality–anatomy combinations and disease prompts, imbalanced training data and the absence of a formal privacy guarantee.
Joseph Cho、Mrudang Mathur、Cyril Zakka 等：《A Generalist Model for Diverse Text-Guided Medical Image Synthesis》，arXiv:2405.09806v7，图1。
Joseph Cho, Mrudang Mathur, Cyril Zakka et al., A Generalist Model for Diverse Text-Guided Medical Image Synthesis, arXiv:2405.09806v7, Figure 1.
把三维 CT 与放射学报告分别编码，用对称对比学习对齐全体扫描的视觉和语言表征，再以冻结图像向量支持检索、零样本分类及独立拟合的疾病与风险模型。

Separate encoders align whole-volume CT and radiology-report representations through symmetric contrastive learning. Frozen image embeddings support retrieval, zero-shot classification and separately fitted disease or prognostic models.
训练输入配对的三维 CT 与放射学报告。期刊版本将 CT 重采样为 1×1×3 mm，截断 HU 至 −1000～1000 并归一化到 [0,1]，补齐、中心裁剪为 XYZ 轴 352×352×128；图像塔的张量顺序为 B×1×128×352×352。

Training takes paired 3D CT volumes and radiology reports. The journal pipeline resamples CT to 1×1×3 mm, clips HU to −1000…1000, normalizes to [0,1], then pads and center-crops to XYZ dimensions 352×352×128. The vision tensor is B×1×128×352×352.
图像与文本位于同一表示空间。Tiny、Small、Base 的共享维度分别为 192、384、768；Base 输出 768 维图像或文本向量。相似度用于跨模态检索及提示词分类，独立训练的下游头再输出疾病概率或 Cox 风险分数。

Image and text lie in a shared space of 192, 384 or 768 dimensions for Tiny, Small and Base. Base produces a 768-dimensional image or text vector. Similarity supports cross-modal retrieval and prompt classification; separately trained downstream heads produce disease probabilities or Cox risk scores.
体数据标准化
Volume standardization
统一朝向、物理间隔、HU 范围和空间尺寸。XYZ 与 PyTorch 的 DHW 顺序要区分；发布配置把 XYZ 尺寸反转后交给视觉塔，预处理后的间隔不能由张量尺寸直接推断。

Standardize orientation, physical spacing, HU range and spatial size. Distinguish XYZ from PyTorch DHW: the release reverses XYZ image dimensions before building the vision tower, and tensor size alone does not establish voxel spacing.
三维卷积分块
3D convolutional patches
以空间 XYZ 的 16×16×8 体素为块；实现的 DHW 核与步长为 8×16×16。128×352×352 输入得到 16×22×22=7744 个区域标记，三维卷积将每块映射为 Transformer 特征。

Use XYZ patches of 16×16×8 voxels, implemented with DHW kernel and stride 8×16×16. A 128×352×352 volume yields a 16×22×22 grid, or 7,744 regional tokens, projected into Transformer features by a 3D convolution.
位置编码与全局标记
Position encoding and global token
为区域标记加入三维空间位置，前置一个 CLS 全局标记。固定代码对 AugReg 位置编码进行空间适配；完整序列包含 7744 个区域标记与 1 个全局标记。
Add 3D spatial position information and prepend a CLS token. The pinned implementation adapts AugReg position embeddings; the full sequence contains 7,744 regional tokens and one global token.
AugReg 视觉 Transformer
AugReg vision Transformer
在完整体数据序列上做多头自注意力。CLS 与所有区域标记双向交换信息，在多层中聚合扫描级结构；这里不是逐切片独立编码后再做层级注意力。

Multi-head self-attention operates on the full volume sequence. CLS exchanges information with all regional tokens and aggregates scan-level structure across layers; this is not independent per-slice encoding followed by hierarchical attention.
图像投影与归一化
Image projection and normalization
取最后一层归一化后的 CLS 输出，再以线性头映射到共享维度。Base 为 768 维；计算对比相似度前做 L2 归一化，使内积对应余弦相似度。
Take the final normalized CLS output and project it linearly into the shared space, 768 dimensions for Base. L2 normalization before contrastive similarity makes the dot product a cosine similarity.
报告文本编码
Report text encoding
另一条并行路径将报告分词并提供注意力掩码，送入 CXR-BERT-specialized。固定语言塔取第一个标记的最终隐状态，再通过线性投影与对应视觉变体对齐。

A parallel path tokenizes the report, supplies an attention mask and encodes it with CXR-BERT-specialized. The pinned language tower takes the first-token final hidden state and linearly projects it to the matching vision variant’s shared dimension.
批内图文相似度矩阵
In-batch image–text similarity
对 B 个扫描与 B 份报告形成 B×B 相似度矩阵。对角线对应真实图文对，其余项是批内负对；分布式训练先汇集多 GPU 特征，扩充对比集合。

A batch of B scans and B reports forms a B×B similarity matrix. The diagonal contains matched pairs and off-diagonal entries provide in-batch negatives. Distributed training gathers features across GPUs before constructing the contrastive set.
双向对比目标
Symmetric contrastive objective
同时优化图像找报告与报告找图像，两个方向的交叉熵取平均。相似度的缩放影响 softmax 锐度；公式的除数温度与代码的乘数缩放须按各自约定解释。

Optimize image-to-report and report-to-image matching, averaging cross-entropy in the two directions. Similarity scaling controls softmax sharpness; divisor temperature in the formula and multiplier scale in code must be interpreted under their own conventions.
检索与提示词分类
Retrieval and prompt classification
推理时可只编码 CT，并与预先编码的报告或“病变存在／不存在”提示比较。图文向量是匹配表示；双编码器本身不逐词生成报告，也不输出分割掩码。

At inference, CT embeddings can be compared with pre-encoded reports or pathology-present/pathology-absent prompts. These are matching representations: the dual encoder itself does not generate report tokens or segmentation masks.
冻结表征后的任务建模
Task models on frozen representations
将图像塔的向量作为独立模型的输入。论文疾病分类使用按解剖视野分别拟合的 L1 逻辑回归，预后使用 ridge Cox 模型；这些拟合目标与图文预训练目标不同。

Use vision-tower vectors as inputs to separate models. The paper fits field-of-view-specific L1 logistic regressions for disease classification and ridge Cox models for prognosis. Their fitting objectives differ from image–text pretraining.
窄解剖视野、单一造影条件或单一临床任务上的训练，限制了 CT 表征覆盖真实扫描差异的能力。
Training in narrow anatomical windows, contrast settings or clinical tasks limits coverage of real-world CT variation.
将全体 CT 的三维视觉编码器与报告文本编码器对齐，让医学报告提供扫描级语义监督。
Align a whole-volume 3D vision encoder with a report encoder so that radiology text supplies scan-level semantic supervision.
期刊路线以 AugReg ViT 的三维分块与 CXR-BERT-specialized 组成双塔，并在不同视野、造影条件和临床用途的配对数据上统一训练。
The journal route pairs a 3D-patch AugReg ViT with CXR-BERT-specialized and trains jointly across fields of view, contrast settings and clinical indications.
同一 CT 表征被用于跨模态检索、胸部病变提示词分类、实验室指标关联、疾病分类和纵向风险研究；后几项通过独立统计或预测模型实现。

The same CT representation supports retrieval, thoracic prompt classification, laboratory associations, disease classification and longitudinal risk research. The latter uses separate statistical or predictive models.
外部 CT-RATE、院内验证及生物学关联回答不同问题。相似度分数、疾病概率与风险排序不可互换，观察性关联也不直接给出因果解释。

External CT-RATE validation, internal evaluation and biological association studies answer different questions. Similarity, disease probability and risk rank are not interchangeable, and observational association does not directly establish causality.
三维块包含局部体素关系，完整序列注意力再连接远距离区域。以给定尺寸计算，区域标记数为 (128÷8)×(352÷16)×(352÷16)=7744，加上 CLS 后共 7745；输入分辨率改变会显著改变注意力计算规模。

Volumetric patches encode local voxel relationships, while full-sequence attention links distant regions. At the stated size, (128÷8)×(352÷16)×(352÷16)=7,744 regional tokens plus CLS gives 7,745 tokens. Resolution changes can substantially alter attention cost.
两条编码路径在相似度空间相遇，不是在视觉编码中交叉注意全部报告词元。配对监督鼓励扫描与其报告相近，但报告未描述的影像细节不一定得到同等强度监督。

The two encoders meet in similarity space rather than cross-attending every report token inside the vision tower. Pair supervision brings a scan closer to its report; details omitted from the report need not receive equally strong supervision.
视觉参数约 6M、22M、86M 仅对应 Tiny、Small、Base 视觉塔。它们的共享空间为 192、384、768 维，不是所有变体都采用 768 维，也不能把视觉参数数目当成双塔总参数。

The approximate 6M, 22M and 86M parameter counts refer only to Tiny, Small and Base vision towers. Shared dimensions are 192, 384 and 768. Not every variant is 768-dimensional, and vision-only counts are not two-tower totals.
期刊预训练使用 436,787 个 CT—报告对、51,966 名参与者。配对验证集为 46,535 个体数据、5,774 名参与者；额外无报告验证 CT 用于图像侧下游分析。组合验证队列按论文报告为 123,603 个 CT、20,599 名参与者，不把子组人数直接相加。

Journal pretraining uses 436,787 CT–report pairs from 51,966 participants. Paired validation contains 46,535 volumes from 5,774 participants; additional unpaired CT is used for image-side downstream analyses. Use the reported combined validation cohort of 123,603 CT volumes and 20,599 participants rather than summing subgroup participant counts.
AdamW、初始学习率 5×10⁻⁵、每 GPU 批量 48、4 张 NVIDIA B200 对应全局有效批量 192。固定 Base YAML 设定 16 个 epoch、clip 损失且不冻结语言塔；这些是所审阅发布配置，不是自选的最优训练建议。

AdamW, initial learning rate 5×10⁻⁵, per-GPU batch size 48 and four NVIDIA B200 GPUs yield a global batch size of 192. The pinned Base YAML sets 16 epochs, clip loss and an unfrozen language tower. These are reviewed release settings, not independently optimized recommendations.
本页公式采用标准除数温度 τ 的对称对比目标。期刊文字记 τ=10；固定代码的 CLIP 分支在未启用可学习缩放时把余弦相似度乘 10，若启用则使用 exp(logit_scale)。这两种写法不应被直接说成同一个数值温度。

The formula here uses the standard divisor-temperature τ convention. Journal prose states τ=10; the pinned CLIP branch instead multiplies cosine similarity by 10 when learnable scaling is disabled, or uses exp(logit_scale) when enabled. The numerical conventions should not be equated without conversion.
本文以 2026 年期刊 Article in Press 与固定 v2 实现解释机制。首次预印本于 2025-07-03 公开，期刊于 2026-09-29 发表；早期 v1 的 DeiT、Clinical Longformer、粗块尺寸和 512 维表示不套用到本页 v2。

The explanation follows the 2026 journal Article in Press and pinned v2 implementation. The first preprint appeared on 2025-07-03; the journal article appeared on 2026-09-29. Earlier v1 choices—DeiT, Clinical Longformer, coarse patches and 512-dimensional features—are not attributed to this v2 route.
复现应同时固定物理间隔、轴顺序、空间裁剪、分块尺寸、所选双塔和投影维度，并按参与者划分数据。图像嵌入归一化与分类器的特征标准化是不同操作，要按具体下游协议处理。

Reproduction should pin physical spacing, axis order, crop, patch size, tower choice and projection dimension, with participant-level splitting. Image-embedding L2 normalization and classifier feature standardization are distinct operations governed by the downstream protocol.
跨模态检索比较 CT 与报告的共享向量；提示词分类比较同一病变的存在与不存在描述。它们使用文本相似度，不等同于已经校准的临床患病概率。

Cross-modal retrieval compares CT and report vectors; prompt classification compares present/absent descriptions of one pathology. Both use text similarity rather than an already calibrated clinical disease probability.
论文外部 CT-RATE 验证保留每个检查一个 CT，共 1,564 个体数据、18 类胸部标签，并区分零样本提示词分类与在 CT-RATE 训练数据上另拟合的线性探测。
External CT-RATE evaluation retains one CT per study, totaling 1,564 volumes and 18 thoracic labels. It distinguishes zero-shot prompts from linear probes separately fitted on CT-RATE training data.
疾病分类按胸部、腹部／盆腔分别拟合 L1 逻辑回归，使用影像时间附近的疾病状态；纵向预后则以基线之前无对应诊断者为对象，拟合 ridge Cox 风险模型。二者的队列和目标不同。

Disease classification fits L1 logistic regression separately for chest and abdomen/pelvis fields of view, targeting disease status near imaging. Longitudinal prognosis instead excludes prior diagnoses of the target condition and fits ridge Cox models. Their cohorts and objectives differ.
实验室指标关联和疾病表型分析使用从训练集拟合的 PCA 坐标，并在验证人群中开展发现与复现。统计显著的坐标关联帮助研究表征，但不意味着某个潜变量就是一个独立生物学机制。

Laboratory and disease-phenotype association analyses use PCA axes fitted on training embeddings and discovery–replication analyses in validation participants. Significant associations help characterize representations without identifying each latent coordinate as an independent biological mechanism.
期刊中的合成实验室数值来自额外三层 MLP，输入完整图像表征及影像与化验的时间差，用被试分组交叉验证；它不是双塔预训练自动输出的检验报告。

Synthetic laboratory values in the paper come from an additional three-layer MLP using complete image features and the imaging-to-assay time difference, evaluated with subject-grouped cross-validation. They are not test reports automatically produced by dual-encoder pretraining.
PMBB 的病例来源、影像视野和造影方式影响表征及验证范围。代码和已发布模型的可获取性，与原始患者影像、报告及生物库数据的访问条件分别处理。

PMBB case mix, field of view and contrast administration affect the learned representation and evaluation scope. Availability of code or released models is distinct from access conditions for original patient CT, reports and biobank data.
期刊架构
Journal architecture
期刊第 11 页描述 AugReg ViT 的三维分块、7744 个区域标记、CLS 与 CXR-BERT-specialized 双塔。
Journal page 11 describes 3D-patch AugReg ViT, 7,744 regional tokens, CLS and the CXR-BERT-specialized dual encoder.
固定 Base 配置
Pinned Base configuration
固定 YAML 指定投影维度 768，DHW 块 8×16×16、XYZ 输入 352×352×128、AugReg Base、CXR-BERT-specialized、clip 损失与 16 个 epoch。
The pinned YAML specifies dimension 768, DHW patches 8×16×16, XYZ input 352×352×128, AugReg Base, CXR-BERT-specialized, clip loss and 16 epochs.
体数据计算路径
Volumetric computation
固定视觉塔用三维卷积替换二维分块、加入三维位置、前置 CLS，执行完整 Transformer 块，再取归一化 CLS 线性投影。
The pinned vision tower replaces 2D patching with a 3D convolution, adds 3D positions and CLS, executes full Transformer blocks, then projects the normalized CLS output.
文本计算路径
Text computation
固定语言塔的 CXR-BERT 配置使用首标记池化及线性层，输出与选定视觉变体相同的共享维度。
The pinned CXR-BERT language configuration uses first-token pooling and a linear layer to match the selected vision variant’s shared dimension.
双向训练目标
Bidirectional training objective
实现先对图文向量归一化，ClipLoss 对两个方向交叉熵取平均；分布式场景汇集多卡特征。
The implementation normalizes image/text features, averages cross-entropy in both directions and gathers multi-GPU features for distributed contrastive loss.
温度记法
Temperature convention
期刊的除数温度文字与固定代码的乘数缩放约定不同；本页仅给出明确定义的对称目标，不据此声称逐数值训练复现。

Journal divisor-temperature prose and the pinned implementation’s multiplier scale use different conventions. This page defines the symmetric objective explicitly without claiming a numerically exact training reproduction.
外部评估协议
External evaluation protocol
期刊第 12 页区分 CT-RATE 上的零样本分类与另行训练的线性探测，并报告验证队列为 1564 个 CT、18 类胸部标签。
Journal page 12 separates zero-shot classification from separately trained linear probing on CT-RATE, with 1,564 validation CT volumes and 18 thoracic labels.

第 13 页将疾病分类的 L1 逻辑回归与预后的 ridge Cox 分别拟合，并说明病例定义、队列与验证协议。
Page 13 fits L1 logistic classification and ridge Cox prognosis separately and specifies outcome definitions, cohorts and evaluation protocols.

以二元交叉熵评价这些给定分数，每个对象的损失都是 −ln(0.5)，平均损失为 0.6931。阈值采用 ≥，四个对象都预测为阳性，错两个。

候选分数设为 [0.1, 0.2, 0.8, 0.9]。这是一组用于解释目标函数的给定数值，不是一次已完成训练的实验结果。四个正确类别的概率依次是 0.9、0.8、0.8、0.9。

What you will understand
能用输入、输出和学习信号描述一个医学 AI 问题，并区分主要学习方式。
Describe a biomedical AI problem through its inputs, outputs and learning signal, and distinguish the main learning settings.
人工智能关注让机器完成感知、推理、规划等任务；机器学习是其中一类方法，通过数据调整模型，而不是为每种情况手写规则。深度学习又是机器学习的一部分，用多层可学习变换逐步形成表示。例如，传统分类器可以读取人工测量的病灶直径，卷积网络则可以从像素学习局部纹理及其组合。层数多不直接等于能力强：任务定义、样本质量、训练目标与验证方式共同决定模型是否有用。

Artificial intelligence concerns tasks such as perception, reasoning and planning. Machine learning is one way to build such systems: data adjusts a model instead of a programmer writing every decision rule. Deep learning is a form of machine learning that learns representations through multiple transformations. A conventional classifier might use a manually measured lesion diameter; a convolutional network can learn features from pixels. More layers do not automatically make a better system. The task, examples, training objective and evaluation design all contribute to whether a model is useful.
监督学习使用输入与目标的配对，例如胸片和对应诊断标签，或图像和逐像素分割。无监督学习研究没有这类人工目标的数据结构，例如聚类和降维。自监督学习从数据本身构造训练目标：遮住图像块再重建，或让同一图像的两种视图得到相关表示。它通常归入无监督学习，但目标仍由人设计。预训练不使用疾病标签，并不代表下游预测不需要标签，也不代表训练数据中没有患者信息。

Supervised learning uses paired inputs and targets, such as radiographs with diagnosis labels or images with segmentation masks. Unsupervised learning studies structure without those human-provided targets, for example through clustering or dimensionality reduction. Self-supervised learning constructs targets from the data itself: it may reconstruct hidden image patches or align two views of one image. It is commonly grouped with unsupervised learning, although people still design the objective. Pretraining without disease labels does not eliminate the need for downstream labels or remove patient information from the training data.
把“识别疾病”改写成可检查的任务：输入是什么、在什么时间可获得、输出对应哪个对象、参考标准怎样得到。例如，输入一次检查的胸片，输出检查级阳性概率；这与给每个像素标记肺野是两个任务。还要写清适用人群、预测时间窗和评价单位。随后选择简单基线，再考虑复杂架构。如此阅读模型论文时，可以先问它解决了哪种输入到输出的映射，再问结构带来了什么改变。

Turn a broad aim such as “detect disease” into a task that can be inspected. Specify the input, when it is available, the object receiving the prediction and how the reference standard is obtained. Predicting a positive probability for one radiographic examination differs from labeling each lung pixel. Also define the target population, prediction horizon and evaluation unit. Start with a simple baseline before selecting a complex architecture. When reading a paper, first identify its input-to-output mapping; then ask what the proposed architecture changes about that mapping.

预测是否存在某种异常是分类；估计病灶面积是回归；标记每个像素的病灶归属是分割。任务不同，目标张量、损失函数和指标也不同。

Predicting whether an abnormality is present is classification; estimating lesion area is regression; assigning a lesion label to each pixel is segmentation. Each task requires a different target tensor, loss and evaluation metric.

能解释批次、通道和空间轴，推导矩阵乘法与简单卷积的输入输出形状。
Explain batch, channel and spatial axes, and derive shapes for matrix multiplication and a simple convolution.
标量是一个数，向量是一列有序数，矩阵有两个轴，张量可有更多轴。这里的“维度”要分清是轴的数量，还是某个轴的长度。一批二维医学图像常写为 N×C×H×W：N 是样本数，C 是通道数，H、W 是高与宽。三维体积再加入深度 D。相同数字可以有不同语义：三张单通道切片不一定等于一张三通道图像。阅读任何形状时，先写轴名，再解释每个数值。

A scalar is a number, a vector is an ordered collection, a matrix has two axes and a tensor may have more. Distinguish the number of axes from the length of one axis. A batch of two-dimensional images is often stored as N×C×H×W: batch size, channels, height and width. A volume adds a depth axis. Equal numbers do not imply equal meanings: three grayscale slices are not necessarily one three-channel image. For every tensor, name its axes before interpreting its numerical shape.
矩阵乘法 XW 要求 X 的最后一轴与 W 的第一轴长度一致。若 X 是 8×10，W 是 10×4，结果就是 8×4，可理解为把八个样本的十个特征映射为四个输出。逐元素相乘则是另一种运算，不能与矩阵乘法混淆。改变形状也不等于改变信息组织：直接重排数组的尺寸，可能把通道与空间混在一起；交换轴应使用明确的转置或轴置换，并检查语义是否保留。

For matrix multiplication XW, the inner dimensions must agree. If X has shape 8×10 and W has shape 10×4, the result has shape 8×4: ten features from each of eight samples become four outputs. Elementwise multiplication is a different operation. Reshaping also differs from rearranging axes. A reshape can silently mix the interpretation of spatial locations and channels if it is used where an axis permutation was needed. Write the intended axis order, use an explicit transpose or permutation, and check that each value retains its meaning.
分割模型常从 N×1×H×W 的灰度图输出 N×K×H×W 的类别分数，其中 K 是类别数，而不是图像数量。分类模型则可能输出 N×K，空间信息已经聚合。批次轴改变一次处理多少样本，通常不改变单个样本的任务定义。体积数据还需要体素间距：相同的 64×64×64 网格可能覆盖不同物理范围。张量形状说明计算布局，间距、方向和坐标系才说明它在真实身体中的位置。

A segmentation model may map grayscale inputs of shape N×1×H×W to class scores of shape N×K×H×W. K is the number of classes, not the number of images. A classifier may instead return N×K after spatial aggregation. Changing the batch axis usually changes throughput rather than the task for an individual sample. Volumes also require voxel spacing: identical 64×64×64 arrays can cover different physical extents. Tensor shape specifies computational layout; spacing, orientation and coordinates specify the relationship to anatomy.

Distinguish sensitivity from positive predictive value, calculate a posterior from prevalence and identify two kinds of uncertainty.
P(A|B) 表示已知 B 时 A 的概率，通常不等于 P(B|A)。敏感度问的是“患病者中有多少检测阳性”，阳性预测值问的是“检测阳性者中有多少患病”，分母已经不同。联合概率描述两件事同时发生，边缘概率则把其他可能情形加总。用一张人数表核对分母，比只背缩写更可靠。医学筛查中的病例比例、入组方式与检测阈值改变后，概率的含义和数值都可能变化。

P(A|B) is the probability of A given B, and generally differs from P(B|A). Sensitivity asks what proportion of people with disease test positive. Positive predictive value asks what proportion of positive tests correspond to disease. Their denominators are different. A joint probability concerns events occurring together; a marginal probability sums over other possibilities. A table of patient counts makes those denominators visible. In screening, changes in prevalence, recruitment and the decision threshold can change both the interpretation and the values of the reported probabilities.
贝叶斯公式把先验概率与检测结果连接起来。先验不是随意猜测，而是当前人群与信息下对事件频率或信念的表达。观测到证据后，用似然说明不同假设产生该证据的可能程度，再归一化得到后验。低患病率人群中，即使检测敏感度较高，假阳性人数仍可能超过真阳性人数。因此不能把“敏感度 90%”直接解释成“阳性者有 90% 概率患病”，还必须知道特异度和患病率。

Bayes’ rule connects a prior probability with new evidence. A prior expresses the event frequency or belief appropriate to the population and information already available. The likelihood describes how probable the evidence is under each hypothesis; normalization produces the posterior. In a population with low disease prevalence, false positives may outnumber true positives even when sensitivity is high. Consequently, “90% sensitivity” does not mean that a person with a positive result has a 90% probability of disease. Specificity and prevalence are also required to answer that question.
数据不确定性来自噪声、模糊图像或标签分歧；模型不确定性与有限训练数据、参数估计和模型设定有关。这种区分有助于决定下一步：重拍检查、补充标注、收集新域数据，还是改进模型。softmax 最大值只是模型内部输出，不能自动测量这两类不确定性；未见过的输入也可能得到很高分数。应结合校准、外部分布检查和具体错误分析，评估概率在目标人群中的实际含义。

Data uncertainty arises from noise, ambiguous images or disagreement in labels. Model uncertainty relates to limited training data, parameter estimation and model assumptions. The distinction helps identify a useful next action: acquire a better image, improve labels, collect examples from a new domain or revise the model. The largest softmax value is an internal output, not an automatic measurement of either uncertainty. Unfamiliar inputs can receive high scores. Calibration, distribution checks and analysis of specific errors are needed to understand what predicted probabilities mean in the intended population.
D 表示患病，+ 表示阳性；后验同时取决于敏感度、假阳性率和先验患病率。
D denotes disease and + a positive result. The posterior depends on sensitivity, false-positive rate and prior prevalence.
一个纯教学的筛查算例
A hypothetical screening calculation
假设 10,000 人中患病率为 1%，敏感度 90%，特异度 95%。100 名患者中约 90 人阳性，9,900 名非患者中约 495 人假阳性。因此阳性预测值为 90÷585，约 15.4%。这些数值仅用于展示计算，不是某个模型的性能。

Assume 10,000 people, 1% prevalence, 90% sensitivity and 95% specificity. Approximately 90 of the 100 people with disease test positive, while 495 of the 9,900 people without disease are false positives. Positive predictive value is 90÷585, about 15.4%. These numbers illustrate arithmetic and do not describe a model benchmark.

预测概率不是因果效应，注意力权重或高置信分数也不能代替概率校准。

生成 20 个患者 ID，每人复制五次；用固定随机种子重复伯努利切片划分 10000 次，再与患者分组划分对照。

The repeated mean mixed-patient count should approach 13.44; individual splits need not equal it.

Patient intersections must be empty in every grouped split.

训练、验证、测试各有职责
Training, validation and test sets have different jobs
预测新患者，就按患者隔离
Group by patient when predicting new patients
泄漏也会藏在预处理里
Leakage can hide in preprocessing
能按预测场景选择划分单位，并把预处理、调参和最终测试放在正确的数据边界内。
Choose split units for the intended prediction setting and place preprocessing, tuning and final testing within the correct data boundaries.
训练集用于拟合参数；验证集用于选择超参数、阈值和停止时间；测试集用于对已经确定的流程进行最终评估。如果反复看测试结果再修改模型，测试集也参与了选择，不再是独立的最终检查。数据较少时，可在开发数据内做交叉验证，每折重新拟合完整流程，同时保留独立测试集。报告时写清患者数、检查数、划分规则和选择过程，不能只写一个随机种子或训练测试比例。

The training set fits parameters. The validation set selects hyperparameters, decision thresholds and stopping times. The test set evaluates the completed procedure. Repeatedly inspecting test results and modifying the model turns that test set into part of model selection. With limited data, use cross-validation within development data, refitting the complete procedure in each fold while preserving an independent test set. Report patient counts, examination counts, splitting rules and selection steps. A random seed or a train-to-test ratio alone does not describe a reproducible evaluation design.
同一患者的切片、重复检查和随访具有相关性。若把切片随机分组，模型可能在训练中见过测试患者的相邻切片或稳定特征，评估的便不是面对新患者的能力。通常先按患者划分，再提取切片和执行增强；如多个患者共享家系或其他强依赖，也要考虑更高层分组。若目标是未来使用，还应增加时间划分；若目标是迁移到新医院，则需要按机构留出数据。切分方式应回答真实使用问题。

Slices, repeat examinations and follow-up studies from one patient are correlated. Randomly splitting slices can expose the model to adjacent images or stable characteristics of a test patient during training. That does not estimate performance on a new patient. Usually split patients before extracting slices or applying augmentation, and consider higher-level grouping when families or other dependencies matter. A future-use setting may also require a temporal split; a new-hospital setting needs a site-held-out evaluation. Choose a split that answers the actual deployment question, rather than whichever split produces the highest score.
标准化的均值与方差、缺失值填补、特征筛选和降维参数，都只能在当前训练折中学习，再应用于验证或测试。先用全体数据挑特征、再交叉验证，仍会泄漏。重采样和数据增强也应留在训练边界内；增强后的同源图像不能跨组。对时间预测，还要检查输入是否在预测时刻已经可用，例如用出院后才写入的字段预测入院风险，会把未来信息带进模型。用流水线固化这些顺序。

Learn standardization statistics, imputation values, feature selection and dimensionality reduction only from the current training fold, then apply them to validation or test data. Selecting features on the full dataset before cross-validation still leaks information. Resampling and augmentation also belong inside the training boundary, and transformed versions of the same source image must not cross groups. In temporal prediction, verify that each input was available at the prediction time. A field recorded after discharge cannot fairly predict admission-time risk. A pipeline makes the fitting order explicit and repeatable.
P 表示患者 ID 集合；评估新患者时，三个集合两两不重叠。
P denotes a set of patient IDs. For evaluation on new patients, all three sets must be pairwise disjoint.
2,000 张切片，不等于 2,000 位独立患者
2,000 slices are not 2,000 independent patients

A teaching dataset contains 100 patients with 20 slices each. Split patients into groups of 70, 15 and 15, then place all slices from each patient into the corresponding training, validation or test set. Apply augmentation afterward and estimate preprocessing statistics using training data alone.
标签分层只保持类别比例，不能自动阻止同一患者、同一次检查或重复图片跨组。
Stratification preserves class proportions; it does not automatically prevent patient, examination or duplicate-image overlap.
交叉验证之前，先用全体样本选出与标签最相关的特征，会发生什么？
What happens if features are selected using all labels before cross-validation?
只要最终测试没训练权重就没有问题
It is safe as long as test data does not update network weights
验证折的信息已经影响特征选择，造成泄漏
Validation information has influenced feature selection, causing leakage
这会自动减少模型方差且保证无偏
It guarantees an unbiased estimate with less variance
特征选择也是学习步骤，必须在每个训练折内重新拟合。
Feature selection is itself a learned step and must be refitted inside each training fold.
先观察两个输入乘以固定权重。预测把 x 增加 1 后，线性分数会增加多少。
Inspect two inputs with fixed weights. Predict how much the linear score increases when x increases by one.
移动 x，检查加权和。图中的边标出实际权重，输出随计算更新。
Move x and inspect the weighted sum. Edges show the actual weights and the output follows the calculation.
把分数映射到 sigmoid 概率。分数可以任意大，概率始终落在零与一之间。
Map the score through sigmoid. Scores are unbounded, while probabilities remain between zero and one.
选择负输入并再次观察。概率输出与最终决策阈值是不同层次。
Choose a negative input and inspect again. A probability and the final decision threshold are separate objects.
概率从 0.49 变为 0.51，表示模型参数一定更新了吗？
If a probability changes from 0.49 to 0.51, must parameters have changed?
不一定。即使参数不变，不同输入也会产生不同概率。
No. Different inputs can produce different probabilities with unchanged parameters.

One synthetic scalar example with target 1.
当前参数，分数 z=wx+b。
Current parameters with score z=wx+b.
全量仅含一个样本，因此单样本与批次梯度相同。
The dataset contains one example, so its gradient is also the full-batch gradient.
sigmoid 概率配合二元交叉熵，不另加正则项。
Sigmoid probability with binary cross-entropy and no regularizer.

Compute score and probability
z=0.5×2−1=0，因此 sigmoid(z)=0.5。真值为 1，这个样本的损失是 −ln(0.5)=0.6931。
z=0.5×2−1=0, so sigmoid(z)=0.5. Since the target is 1, the example loss is −ln(0.5)=0.6931.

Differentiate loss with respect to the score
sigmoid 与二元交叉熵组合后，∂L/∂z=p−y=−0.5。负号表示增加当前分数会降低损失；它不是最终参数梯度。
For sigmoid combined with binary cross-entropy, ∂L/∂z=p−y=−0.5. The negative sign means increasing this score reduces loss; it is not yet the parameter gradient.
沿链式法则分配到参数
Apply the chain rule to parameters
因为 ∂z/∂w=x=2、∂z/∂b=1，所以权重梯度为 −1，偏置梯度为 −0.5。把输入缩放一倍会改变权重梯度，却不直接改变偏置的局部导数。
Because ∂z/∂w=x=2 and ∂z/∂b=1, the weight gradient is −1 and the bias gradient is −0.5. Doubling the input changes the weight gradient but not the local derivative for the bias.
用同一组旧参数同时更新

w′=0.5−0.1×(−1)=0.6 and b′=−1−0.1×(−0.5)=−0.95. Both gradients come from the old parameter state; do not recompute the bias gradient after updating w.

新分数 z′=0.25，新概率 0.5622，新损失 0.5759。这个样本的损失确实下降；这不能推出未见患者上的效果也改善。
The new score is z′=0.25, probability 0.5622, and loss 0.5759. Loss on this example falls; that does not establish improvement on unseen patients.
不调用自动求导，用中心差分检查 w 与 b 的梯度；然后将 y 改为 0，重复一次更新。
Without automatic differentiation, check both gradients with central differences. Then change y to 0 and repeat one update.
差分步长 10⁻⁵ 时，应得到约 −1 与 −0.5。
A finite-difference step of 10⁻⁵ should give approximately −1 and −0.5.
For y=0, updated parameters are w=0.4, b=−1.05, and z=−0.25.
保留更新前与更新后的损失，核对方向与标签一致。
Store before-and-after loss and confirm the update direction matches the target.
线性模型把特征加权相加
A linear model combines weighted features
逻辑回归输出概率
Logistic regression produces a probability
损失是训练时的优化目标
Loss is the objective used in training
能区分数值预测与概率预测，解释平方损失和二元交叉熵怎样引导训练。
Distinguish numerical from probabilistic prediction and explain how squared loss and binary cross-entropy guide training.
线性回归把输入特征乘以权重，再加偏置，得到一个数值预测。权重的意义取决于特征单位与其他特征，例如年龄按“年”还是“月”记录，会改变对应系数的数值。最小二乘通过减少预测与目标的平方差拟合参数，大误差会被更重地惩罚。线性指的是对参数的形式；输入也可以包含预先构造的平方项。先建立这样的基线，能检查数据是否提供有效信号，并给复杂网络一个有意义的参照。

Linear regression multiplies features by weights, adds a bias and returns a numerical prediction. A coefficient depends on feature units and the other included features: recording age in years rather than months changes its numerical value. Least squares fits parameters by minimizing squared prediction errors, giving larger errors greater influence. “Linear” refers to the parameterization; inputs can include constructed features such as squared terms. A simple baseline helps establish whether the available data contains useful predictive signal and provides a meaningful comparison for a complex neural network.
二分类逻辑回归先计算线性分数 z，再用 sigmoid 把它映射到零到一之间。z 可以理解为模型的对数优势；z 为零时，输出为 0.5。概率与最终类别是两个层次：把阈值设为 0.5 只是常见选择，不是所有医学场景的最佳决策。改变阈值可以改变敏感度和特异度，但不会重新训练特征权重。多类别互斥任务常使用 softmax；多标签任务则需要分别定义每个标签的概率。

Binary logistic regression first computes a linear score z, then uses a sigmoid to map it into the interval from zero to one. The score represents model log-odds; z=0 gives probability 0.5. A probability and a final class decision are different objects. A threshold of 0.5 is conventional, not automatically appropriate for every clinical setting. Changing the threshold trades sensitivity against specificity without retraining feature weights. Mutually exclusive multiclass tasks commonly use softmax, whereas multilabel tasks require a separate probability interpretation for each label.
二元交叉熵会惩罚对错误类别给出高概率的预测。目标为阳性时，概率越接近一，损失越小；接近零则损失很大。它与最终报告的准确率不是同一东西：准确率只关心过没过阈值，而交叉熵还关心概率。实际代码常直接把未归一化分数交给带 logits 的损失函数，以得到稳定计算，避免先 sigmoid 后再次处理。损失、采样权重和标签编码要一起核对，否则即使曲线下降，也可能在优化错误任务。

Binary cross-entropy penalizes confident predictions of the wrong class. For a positive target, a probability near one has low loss, while a probability near zero has high loss. This differs from accuracy, which only checks whether a prediction crosses a threshold. Cross-entropy also evaluates the assigned probability. Implementations often pass raw scores directly to a logits-based loss for numerical stability, rather than applying sigmoid twice. Check the loss together with sampling weights and label encoding: a decreasing curve can otherwise mean the system is successfully optimizing the wrong task.
x 是特征，w、b 是参数，y∈{0,1} 是目标；交叉熵评价预测概率 p 对实际标签的支持程度。
x contains features, w and b are parameters and y∈{0,1} is the target. Cross-entropy evaluates the probability p assigned to the observed label.
从分数到概率
From a score to a probability
若一个特征 x=2，权重 w=0.5，偏置 b=−1，则 z=wx+b=0，sigmoid(z)=0.5。对真实阳性样本，二元交叉熵为 −log(0.5)，约 0.693。这个例子只展示模型计算。

For one feature x=2, weight w=0.5 and bias b=−1, the score is z=wx+b=0 and sigmoid(z)=0.5. For a positive target, binary cross-entropy is −log(0.5), approximately 0.693. This is a calculation example, not an empirical model result.
线性或逻辑回归的系数描述条件关联，未经因果设计不能解释为治疗或暴露的因果作用。
Linear or logistic regression coefficients express conditional associations; a causal treatment or exposure effect requires an appropriate causal design.
对于真实阳性样本，哪一个预测的二元交叉熵更小？
For a positive target, which prediction has lower binary cross-entropy?
当 y=1 时，损失为 −log(p)，因此 p 越大损失越小。
When y=1, the loss is −log(p), which decreases as p increases.
两层矩阵之间没有激活时，仍是一条仿射映射。先预测添加 ReLU 后哪些隐藏单元会保留。
Without an activation, two affine layers remain one affine mapping. Predict which hidden units survive a ReLU.
加入 ReLU，再移动输入 x。负隐藏值变为零，正值被保留。
Add ReLU and move x. Negative hidden values become zero and positive values are retained.
输出层汇总这些隐藏值。观察同样的参数怎样因激活状态不同而形成分段映射。
The output layer combines hidden values. See how activation states create a piecewise mapping with unchanged parameters.
让输入穿过零附近。检查“全连接层更多”与“有了非线性”的差别。
Move the input across zero and distinguish adding affine layers from introducing a nonlinearity.
把所有隐藏激活换成恒等函数，会发生什么？
What happens if every hidden activation becomes the identity?
整个网络重新等价于一次仿射映射；增加这种层数不会扩展其函数类别。
The network again collapses to one affine mapping. Adding such layers does not expand its function class.
再换一个空间，观察原理

把结构，放进三维空间。
Explore the structure in three dimensions.

合成回归输入与目标。
Synthetic regression input and target.
隐藏节点 z=w₁x+b₁，h=max(0,z)。
Hidden node z=w₁x+b₁, h=max(0,z).
线性输出 ŷ=w₂h+b₂。
Linear output ŷ=w₂h+b₂.
半平方损失使输出导数恰为 ŷ−y。

归一化与训练、推理模式
Normalization and training–inference modes
能解释隐藏层和激活函数的必要性，追踪一次多层前向计算，并区分训练模式与推理模式。
Explain hidden layers and activations, trace a multilayer forward pass and distinguish training from inference modes.
人工神经元先对输入加权求和，再经过激活函数；早期感知机用阈值函数完成二分类。多层感知机把这样的单元组织为输入层、隐藏层和输出层，让中间表示也参与学习。关键不只是多加矩阵：如果各层只有线性或仿射变换，连续相乘仍可合并为一次仿射变换。隐藏层的非线性让网络能够表示弯曲或分段的关系。宽度描述一层有多少单元，深度描述变换的层次，二者共同影响表示能力和计算量。

An artificial neuron forms a weighted sum of inputs and applies an activation. Early perceptrons used threshold functions for binary classification. A multilayer perceptron organizes units into input, hidden and output layers, making intermediate representations learnable. Adding matrices alone is not enough: a composition containing only linear or affine transformations can still be collapsed into one affine transformation. Nonlinear hidden layers let a network represent curved or piecewise relationships. Width describes the number of units in a layer; depth describes the sequence of transformations. Both affect representation capacity and computational cost.
一次前向计算把输入逐层变成隐藏表示，再变成输出分数。ReLU 把负值置零并保留正值，提供简单的非线性；sigmoid 将数值压到零和一之间，常用于二分类输出，但在饱和区梯度较小。隐藏层激活与输出层激活承担不同职责：回归可以直接输出数值，互斥分类可以从分数计算 softmax，多标签分类则可分别计算 sigmoid。每一步都要同时核对轴、数值范围和目标定义，不能只看最终张量长度。

A forward pass transforms an input into hidden representations and then output scores. ReLU sets negative values to zero and retains positive ones, providing a simple nonlinearity. Sigmoid maps values between zero and one and is useful for binary outputs, although its gradients become small in saturated regions. Hidden and output activations have different jobs. Regression may return numerical values directly; mutually exclusive classification can apply softmax to scores, while multilabel classification can use independent sigmoids. Check axis meanings, value ranges and target definitions at each step, not just the final output length.
输入标准化使用训练数据确定尺度；网络内部的归一化层则处理隐藏表示，两者不是同一个步骤。常见 BatchNorm 在训练中按批次与空间位置统计各通道，并可维护滑动统计量；默认推理时使用保存的统计量。dropout 在训练中随机屏蔽激活，常规推理时关闭这种随机操作。因此评估前要切换模型模式。切换评估模式与关闭梯度记录也是两件事：前者改变这些层的行为，后者减少求导开销；正确推理通常需要把两者一起设置。

Input standardization establishes scales using training data; normalization inside a network acts on hidden representations. They are different steps. Common BatchNorm implementations estimate channel statistics over batch and spatial positions during training and can maintain running estimates, which are used by default during inference. Dropout randomly suppresses activations in training and disables that sampling in ordinary inference. Switch the model to evaluation mode before assessment. Evaluation mode and disabling gradient recording are separate operations: one changes layer behavior, while the other avoids differentiation overhead. Correct inference commonly configures both.
W₁、b₁ 和 W₂、b₂ 是两层参数，σ 是隐藏层激活；输出是否还需概率变换，由目标任务与损失决定。
W₁, b₁ and W₂, b₂ are the two layers’ parameters; σ is the hidden activation. The task and loss determine whether the output needs a probability transformation.

优化器、批次与训练曲线
Optimizers, batches and training curves
能区分前向计算、求梯度和参数更新，并手算一次最简单的梯度下降。
Distinguish forward computation, differentiation and parameter updates, and calculate one simple gradient-descent step.
损失把当前预测质量压缩成一个标量；梯度记录每个参数发生微小变化时，损失会怎样变化。沿负梯度做一个足够小的步长，通常会降低当前局部的损失。这里的“局部”很重要：深度网络的目标通常非凸，一步下降不保证找到全局最优，也不保证测试表现变好。学习率控制步长，过大可能越过稳定区域，过小则进展缓慢。先理解这种方向与尺度的关系，再比较不同优化器。

A loss summarizes prediction quality as a scalar. Its gradient records how that loss changes under a small change in each parameter. A sufficiently small step in the negative-gradient direction generally reduces the current loss locally. The word “locally” matters: deep-network objectives are usually nonconvex, and one descent step guarantees neither a global optimum nor better test performance. The learning rate sets the step size. A large rate can overshoot a stable region; a small rate can make progress slow. Understand direction and scale before comparing named optimizers.
前向计算依次保存中间结果，得到预测和损失；反向传播从损失出发，沿计算图反向应用链式法则，得到参数梯度。它是计算导数的方法，不是优化器本身。自动微分框架替我们组织这项计算，但仍要正确设置可训练参数、清空或有意累积梯度，再执行更新。推理时通常不需要保留反向图，可减少内存。若某处分支被切断或张量被分离，相关参数就不会从这条路径收到梯度。

A forward pass computes intermediate values, predictions and loss. Backpropagation starts at that loss and applies the chain rule backward through the computation graph to obtain parameter gradients. It is a differentiation algorithm, not the optimizer itself. Automatic differentiation organizes the calculation, but the programmer must still select trainable parameters, clear or intentionally accumulate gradients, and perform the update. Inference usually does not require storing a backward graph, reducing memory use. Detaching a tensor or breaking a computation path prevents gradients from passing through that path to earlier parameters.
小批量随机梯度用一部分样本估计整体梯度，因此更新带有噪声；动量积累近期方向，Adam 则利用梯度的一阶、二阶统计调整各参数的更新尺度。批次大小、学习率、学习率计划和训练轮数需要一起理解。排错时同时观察训练与验证损失、梯度范数和学习率，先用很小的训练子集检查能否拟合。训练损失不降，可能是数据、损失或实现问题；验证损失变差，则需要进一步检查泛化与数据分布。

Mini-batch stochastic gradients estimate the full-data gradient from a subset of examples, so updates contain sampling noise. Momentum accumulates recent directions; Adam uses first- and second-moment gradient statistics to adapt update scales. Interpret batch size, learning rate, scheduling and training duration together. During debugging, inspect training and validation losses, gradient norms and learning rates. First check whether the implementation can fit a tiny training subset. Failure to reduce training loss may indicate a data, objective or implementation problem. Worsening validation loss instead calls for examining generalization and data distributions.
θ 是待学习参数，η 是学习率，梯度在当前参数处求值；反向传播计算梯度，优化器使用它更新参数。

能识别常见拟合状态，解释正则化的作用，并在验证边界内比较改进方法。
Recognize common fitting patterns, explain regularization and compare remedies without crossing validation boundaries.
欠拟合表示模型连训练数据中的主要规律都没有捕捉到，可能源于能力不足、特征不合适或优化未完成。过拟合则表现为训练拟合持续改善，但对独立开发样本的表现变差。经典偏差—方差框架用过强假设造成的系统误差，与对训练样本波动的敏感性解释这一现象；现代深度网络的行为更复杂，不能只凭参数量画出固定结论。先检查曲线、数据量、标签与基线，再判断需要增加能力还是约束拟合。

Underfitting means a model has not captured important structure even in the training data. Limited capacity, unsuitable features or incomplete optimization may cause it. Overfitting occurs when training fit improves while performance on independent development examples worsens. The classical bias–variance view contrasts systematic error from restrictive assumptions with sensitivity to the particular training sample. Modern deep networks can behave more intricately, so parameter count alone does not determine generalization. Inspect learning curves, sample size, labels and baselines before deciding whether to add capacity or constrain fitting.
L2 正则化在数据损失之外惩罚较大的权重，改变了模型在多个拟合解之间的偏好；早停用验证集决定训练何时结束；dropout 在训练时随机屏蔽部分激活，改变网络的学习过程。它们不是消除所有错误的按钮，强度过大会导致欠拟合。优化器中的权重衰减与损失里加入 L2 惩罚，也不在所有更新规则下等价，例如 AdamW 使用解耦衰减。比较时需要写清具体实现，而不只写“使用正则化”。

L2 regularization penalizes large weights in addition to data loss, changing the preference among possible fits. Early stopping uses validation data to choose when training ends. Dropout randomly suppresses some activations during training. These methods do not remove every error, and overly strong regularization can cause underfitting. Weight decay implemented by an optimizer is also not equivalent to an L2 loss penalty under every update rule; AdamW uses decoupled decay. A reproducible comparison specifies the actual mechanism and strength rather than simply stating that regularization was used.
数据增强让模型看到训练样本的合理变化，例如有限的旋转、强度扰动或裁剪。关键不是变化越多越好，而是变化后目标是否仍正确：裁剪可能移除病灶，左右翻转可能改变解剖侧别，过强颜色扰动可能破坏染色信息。增强方案只在训练组应用，并用验证数据选择强度。除比较平均指标，还应检查不同医院、设备和人群的错误。更多独立患者和更贴近目标场景的数据，往往比反复增加变换更直接地改善泛化证据。

Augmentation presents plausible variations of training examples, such as limited rotation, intensity changes or cropping. More variation is not automatically better: the target must remain valid. A crop can remove a lesion, a left–right flip can alter anatomical laterality, and excessive color changes can destroy staining information. Apply augmentation to training data and choose its strength using validation data. Examine errors across hospitals, devices and patient groups as well as average scores. More independent patients and data closer to the intended setting often provide more direct evidence for generalization than repeatedly adding transformations.
第一项拟合训练数据，第二项约束参数大小；λ 控制二者的相对权重，应在开发数据上选择。
The first term fits training examples; the second penalizes parameter magnitude. λ sets their relative weight and is selected using development data.
读懂两条曲线
Read two learning curves
固定数据划分后，训练损失从第 10 轮继续下降，验证损失却开始上升。可以把第 10 轮附近作为早停候选，并在开发数据内比较正则化或增强；最终测试集仍保留到方案确定之后。

With a fixed split, training loss continues falling after epoch 10 while validation loss starts rising. A checkpoint around that point becomes an early-stopping candidate. Compare regularization and augmentation using development data, retaining the final test set until the procedure is fixed.
训练集和验证集都很差时，直接增加正则化可能加重欠拟合；先检查优化与数据流程。
If both training and validation performance are poor, stronger regularization may worsen underfitting. Check optimization and the data pipeline first.
哪一种增强需要特别检查标签是否仍正确？
Which augmentation requires checking that the label remains correct?
所有增强都需要
Every augmentation
只有会改变图像尺寸的增强
Only augmentations that change image dimensions
只要损失下降就不需要检查
None, as long as training loss decreases
增强隐含了不变性假设；几何、颜色和强度变化都可能改变医学任务的有效信号或标签。
Augmentation assumes an invariance. Geometric, color and intensity changes can each alter meaningful biomedical signal or invalidate labels.

先编写不依赖深度学习库的双重窗口循环，复现中心响应，再分别旋转核、交换左右列、将输入整体加 10。

感受野怎样逐层扩大
How receptive fields grow
能解释权重共享，计算输出尺寸，并区分理论感受野与实际信息贡献。
Explain weight sharing, calculate output size and distinguish theoretical receptive field from actual information contribution.
卷积层让小窗口在输入上滑动，每个位置使用同一组可学习权重计算输出。深度学习库通常执行不翻转核的互相关，但沿用“卷积”名称。权重共享降低参数需求，并利用局部模式可在不同位置出现的假设。单个输出通道会汇总所有输入通道的贡献，不只是处理某一种颜色。多个核形成多个特征图，经非线性后再交给下一层；边缘、纹理或更复杂表示，都是训练目标和数据共同塑造的结果。

A convolutional layer slides a small window over the input, applying the same learned weights at every position. Deep-learning libraries generally implement cross-correlation without flipping the kernel, while retaining the name convolution. Weight sharing reduces parameter requirements and encodes the assumption that local patterns may occur at different locations. One output channel combines contributions from all input channels; it is not restricted to one color. Multiple kernels produce feature maps, which pass through nonlinearities into later layers. Their learned representations depend on both the training data and objective.
步幅决定窗口每次移动多少格；填充在边界补值，影响边缘处理与输出尺寸；空洞率让核元素之间留出间隔，以较少参数覆盖更大范围。它们改变的不是同一件事。下采样减少空间分辨率与计算量，也可能丢失细小目标。医学图像还要结合物理间距理解核的范围：相同的三层切片，在薄层和厚层扫描中覆盖的毫米数不同。设计二维或三维网络时，不能只看像素数量而忽略体素间距。

Stride controls how far the window moves. Padding supplies boundary values and affects output size. Dilation inserts gaps between kernel elements, covering a wider region without adding the corresponding number of parameters. These operations serve different purposes. Downsampling lowers spatial resolution and computation but can lose small targets. For biomedical images, physical spacing also matters: three slices span different distances in thin- and thick-slice scans. Choosing a two- or three-dimensional architecture therefore requires considering voxel spacing and acquisition geometry, rather than only counting pixels or slices.
某个输出位置的理论感受野，是沿计算图追溯后可能影响它的输入范围。两层步幅为一的 3×3 卷积，在没有空洞时得到 5×5 的理论感受野，而不是 6×6；重叠区域会共享。理论上可到达的输入，并不一定对结果贡献相同，实际梯度或信息贡献可能集中在其中一部分。U-Net 的下采样路径汇总上下文，跳连把较高分辨率特征送回解码器，兼顾定位和语义；这也解释了为什么要同时检查结构与空间尺寸。

The theoretical receptive field of an output location is the range of input positions that could influence it through the computation graph. Two stride-one 3×3 convolutions without dilation yield a 5×5 receptive field, not 6×6, because their windows overlap. Potential reach does not imply equal contribution: gradients or useful information may concentrate within a smaller region. In U-Net, the contracting path aggregates context while skip connections return higher-resolution features to the decoder. Understanding this combination requires tracking both the architecture and its spatial dimensions.
I、O 是单个空间轴的输入和输出长度，k 是核大小，p 是单侧填充，s 是步幅，d 是空洞率。
I and O are the input and output lengths along one spatial axis; k is kernel size, p padding per side, s stride and d dilation.

输入宽度为 32，卷积核宽度 3，步幅 1，填充 0，空洞率 1，输出宽度为 30。若改为两侧各填充 1，输出宽度为 32。再增加输出通道会增加特征图数量，不会自动增加空间分辨率。

For input width 32, kernel width 3, stride 1, padding 0 and dilation 1, output width is 30. Padding by one on each side produces width 32. Increasing output channels adds feature maps; it does not itself increase spatial resolution.
更大的理论感受野不等于模型一定利用了更远处的解剖关系；还要用实验检查。
A larger theoretical receptive field does not establish that the model uses distant anatomical relationships. That requires empirical investigation.

第一层覆盖 3×3，第二层在每个轴上再向两侧各增加一个位置，合计 5×5。
The first layer covers 3×3. The second adds one input position on each side of each axis, producing 5×5.

先做点积，而不是直接分配百分比

查询与三个键的点积依次为 1、0、1。除以 √2 后得到分数 [0.7071,0,0.7071]；缩放来自键维度，而不是候选数量 3。
Dot products with the three keys are 1, 0, and 1. Dividing by √2 gives scores [0.7071,0,0.7071]. Scaling uses key dimension, not the number of candidates.
稳定归一化为一组共同竞争的权重

对所有分数同时减去最大值再指数化，权重为 [0.4011, 0.1978, 0.4011]，总和为 1。单独对每个分数做 sigmoid 不会得到这组权重。
Subtract the shared maximum before exponentiation. Weights are [0.4011, 0.1978, 0.4011], summing to 1. Applying sigmoid independently to scores does not produce these weights.
用权重汇总值，而不是汇总键
Aggregate values, not keys
输出第一坐标为 2a₁+a₃=1.2033；第二坐标为 2a₂+a₃=0.7967。输出仍是一个二维向量，不是三个注意力权重本身。
The first output coordinate is 2a₁+a₃=1.2033; the second is 2a₂+a₃=0.7967. The output is a two-dimensional vector, not the three attention weights themselves.
遮掉一个位置，重新归一化其余位置

把第三个位置的分数设为 −∞，其权重变为 0；前两个位置的权重变为 [0.6698,0.3302]。输出约为 [1.3395,0.6605]，不能只删除旧输出中的第三项而不改其余权重。

Masking position 3 with −∞ gives it zero weight. The first two weights become [0.6698,0.3302], producing approximately [1.3395,0.6605]. Merely deleting the third term without renormalizing is incorrect.
解释这种机制能证明什么

权重描述当前查询如何混合可见值向量；它不是某个医学因素的因果贡献。多头注意力会并行学习多组查询、键和值，然后组合各头输出。

Weights describe how this query mixes visible value vectors; they are not causal contributions of medical factors. Multi-head attention learns several query–key–value projections in parallel and combines their outputs.
实现点积、减最大值 softmax、矩阵汇总与布尔掩码四个步骤，再把所有原始分数统一加上 1000。
Implement dot products, max-subtracted softmax, weighted aggregation, and a Boolean mask as separate steps. Then add 1,000 to every raw score.
加上共同常数后，权重与输出保持不变。
Weights and output stay unchanged after adding a shared constant.
每个未完全遮蔽查询的权重和应为 1，遮蔽位置的权重应为 0。
Each non-fully-masked query must have weights summing to 1, with zero weight at masked positions.
记录全位置被遮蔽时的处理策略，避免对 [−∞,−∞,−∞] 直接计算得到未定义值。
Specify behavior for a fully masked query instead of directly evaluating an undefined softmax over [−∞,−∞,−∞].
查询、键和值各做什么
What queries, keys and values do
沿着形状理解计算
Follow the computation through its shapes
Transformer 还有位置与前馈网络
A Transformer also needs position and feed-forward computation
能解释 Q、K、V 的作用，沿形状读懂自注意力，并理解位置编码与计算成本。
Explain Q, K and V, track self-attention shapes and understand position information and computational cost.
注意力把“向谁取信息”与“取到什么信息”分开。查询 Q 与键 K 比较，得到位置之间的匹配分数；归一化后，用这些权重汇总值 V。自注意力的三者都来自同一序列的可学习投影，交叉注意力则让查询来自一组输入，键和值来自另一组。分数依赖当前内容，因此同一个位置可以在不同样本中选择不同的信息来源。它不是把某个通道永久标成重要，而是一次前向计算中的动态加权。

Attention separates where information is retrieved from what information is retrieved. Queries Q are compared with keys K to produce matching scores between positions. After normalization, those weights aggregate values V. In self-attention, all three are learned projections of the same sequence. In cross-attention, queries come from one input while keys and values come from another. The scores depend on current content, so a position can use different information sources for different samples. This is dynamic weighting in a forward pass, not a permanent declaration that one channel is important.
若有 T 个词元，每个查询和键有 d 维，QK 的转置乘积会形成 T×T 的关系矩阵。除以 √d 可以调节点积分数的尺度，再按每个查询所在行做 softmax，得到和为一的权重。多头注意力用多组投影并行汇总信息，随后融合；它不保证每一头自动对应某种医学概念。标准稠密自注意力的关系矩阵随 T 的平方增长，三维图像切成大量词元后成本很高，因此出现窗口、分层或稀疏等设计。

For T tokens with d-dimensional queries and keys, multiplying Q by the transpose of K produces a T×T relationship matrix. Dividing by √d adjusts the scale of dot-product scores. Row-wise softmax gives weights that sum to one for each query. Multi-head attention uses several projection groups in parallel and combines their outputs; individual heads are not guaranteed to correspond to medical concepts. Standard dense self-attention stores relationships that grow quadratically with T. Large three-dimensional images can generate many tokens, motivating windowed, hierarchical or sparse alternatives.
仅做内容匹配，模型缺少词元顺序或空间坐标的明确提示，因此通常加入位置编码或位置偏置。Transformer 模块还包含逐词元前馈网络、残差连接和归一化，不能把整个架构等同于一张注意力热图。ViT 把图像切成块并投影为词元，医学分割模型则要把表示还原到空间输出。热图可以帮助检查信息流，但高权重不直接等于病因、临床证据或完整解释；要结合扰动、对照与任务评估阅读。

Content matching alone does not explicitly supply sequence order or spatial coordinates, so architectures commonly add positional encodings or biases. A Transformer block also contains token-wise feed-forward computation, residual connections and normalization. The architecture cannot be reduced to an attention heatmap. ViT projects image patches into tokens, while segmentation systems must connect representations back to spatial predictions. Attention maps can help inspect information flow, but a high weight is not automatically a cause, clinical evidence or a complete explanation. Read them alongside perturbations, controls and task-level evaluation.
Q 与 K 决定检索权重，dₖ 是键向量长度，V 提供被汇总的信息；softmax 沿每个查询的候选键归一化。
Q and K determine retrieval weights, dₖ is key-vector length and V supplies the aggregated information. Softmax normalizes over candidate keys for each query.
从图像块到关系矩阵
From patches to a relationship matrix
把 224×224 图像切为 16×16 的互不重叠图像块，会得到 14×14=196 个词元。若再添加一个分类词元，单头完整自注意力的分数矩阵为 197×197，而不是 224×224。

Splitting a 224×224 image into non-overlapping 16×16 patches yields 14×14=196 tokens. Adding a classification token gives 197 tokens, so a full single-head attention score matrix has shape 197×197 rather than 224×224.

一对正样本、两个负样本，手算对比损失

Synthetic cosine similarities between normalized representations.

第一个候选是同一对象的正视图。
The first candidate is a positive view of the same object.
另外两个候选暂按不同对象处理；这是假设而非生物学真值。
Two other candidates are treated as different objects; this is an assumption rather than biological ground truth.
区分相似度与归一化概率

相似度除以温度后得到 logits=[4,1,−0.5]。相似度 0.8 本身并不是正确配对概率 80%；概率还取决于其他候选与温度。
Dividing similarities by temperature gives logits [4,1,−0.5]. Similarity 0.8 does not itself mean an 80% probability of a correct pair; other candidates and temperature also matter.
手算正候选所占的指数质量

稳定 softmax 后，三个候选权重约为 [0.9426, 0.0469, 0.0105]。正候选占比为 0.9426。
Stable softmax gives candidate weights approximately [0.9426, 0.0469, 0.0105]. The positive candidate receives 0.9426.
计算 InfoNCE 与随机参照

损失为 −ln(p₊)=0.059114。若三个候选分数完全相同，正候选占比为 1/3，损失为 ln3=1.098612；这只是给定候选集合的参照。
Loss is −ln(p₊)=0.059114. Equal scores would give the positive a probability of 1/3 and loss ln3=1.098612, a reference for this candidate set only.
看清梯度想推动哪个量
Identify the gradient’s direction
对正相似度的导数为 (p₊−1)/τ=-0.2870，所以沿负梯度会增加正相似度。负候选的导数是 p₋/τ，为正，优化希望压低它们。

The derivative with respect to positive similarity is (p₊−1)/τ=-0.2870, so descent increases that similarity. Negative-candidate derivatives are p₋/τ, which are positive, pushing those similarities down.
把“负样本”假设带回数据

不同患者可能共享相同生物状态，同一患者的不同区域也可能确有差异。增强策略与负样本构造决定模型被要求忽略或保留什么，不能只追求更小的对比损失。

Different patients can share a biological state, while regions from one patient can genuinely differ. Augmentations and negative-pair construction determine which differences the model ignores or preserves; minimizing contrastive loss alone does not settle that choice.
将第一个负相似度从 0.2 改为 0.75，再比较 τ=0.1、0.2、0.5 的损失与正相似度梯度。
Change the first negative similarity from 0.2 to 0.75. Compare loss and the positive-similarity gradient at τ=0.1, 0.2, and 0.5.
固定温度时，加入更难区分的负候选会提高该例的损失。
At fixed temperature, making a negative harder increases this example’s loss.
若给所有相似度加同一个常数，损失不变；如果只提高正相似度，损失下降。
Adding one constant to every similarity leaves loss unchanged; increasing only the positive similarity lowers it.
把可能属于同一生物状态的“假负例”单独标记，再设计不使用它的对照。
Flag possible false negatives from the same biological state and design a comparison excluding them.
对比学习怎样定义相似
How contrastive learning defines similarity
掩码学习从可见部分预测缺失部分
Masked learning predicts missing information
迁移策略决定在比较什么
Adaptation strategy determines the comparison
能比较对比学习与掩码学习，并区分线性探测、微调和真正的外部泛化。
Compare contrastive and masked learning, and distinguish linear probing, fine-tuning and external generalization.
以 SimCLR 为例，同一张图像经过两次增强得到正样本对，模型把它们的表示拉近，并与批次中的其他视图比较。这里的相似关系不是自然给定的，而是由增强和样本构造定义。若增强去掉了关键病灶，模型可能被迫忽略诊断信息；若把不同患者的相同病理现象都当作需要区分的负样本，目标与临床语义也可能不完全一致。理解对比方法时，要同时检查编码器、投影头、样本配对和损失设计。

In SimCLR, two augmentations of one image form a positive pair. The objective aligns their representations while comparing them with other views in the batch. Similarity is not simply given by nature: augmentations and pair construction define it. An augmentation that removes a diagnostic lesion may encourage the representation to ignore useful information. Treating images from different patients as negatives can also conflict with shared pathological meaning. To understand a contrastive method, examine its encoder, projection head, pairing rules and objective together, rather than looking only at the backbone architecture.
掩码学习遮住部分输入，再要求模型预测缺失内容或对应表示。MAE 用可见图像块编码，并用解码器重建被遮挡像素；这让训练目标来自输入本身。重建得好不等于诊断得好，因为像素细节、背景纹理与任务相关结构的价值不同。阅读时要看遮挡比例、预测对象、编码器实际看到哪些内容，以及评估是在冻结表示还是充分微调后完成。自监督减少人工标注需求，但仍需要数据清洗和训练集边界。

Masked learning hides part of an input and predicts the missing content or its representation. MAE encodes visible image patches and uses a decoder to reconstruct masked pixels, deriving targets from the input itself. Strong reconstruction does not automatically imply strong diagnosis: pixel detail, background texture and task-relevant structure carry different value. Check the masking ratio, prediction target, information visible to the encoder and whether evaluation freezes the representation or fine-tunes it. Self-supervision can reduce annotation requirements while still requiring data curation and explicit separation of development and evaluation data.
线性探测冻结编码器，只训练一个简单预测头，用来检查已有表示的可用性；微调则更新部分或全部编码器参数，使其适应新任务。两种结果不能直接当作同一种设置比较。还要核查预训练数据与测试集是否有患者、图像或机构重叠，说明使用了多少下游标签、调参预算和随机重复。自然图像上的提升不自动等同于病理或 MRI 上的提升。可靠迁移要在目标任务、目标人群与外部数据中分别建立证据。

Linear probing freezes the encoder and trains a simple prediction head to assess the existing representation. Fine-tuning updates some or all encoder parameters for the new task. Results from these settings are not interchangeable. Check pretraining overlap with test patients, images or institutions, and report downstream label counts, tuning budgets and repeated runs. Improvements on natural images do not automatically transfer to pathology or MRI. Establish evidence separately for the intended task, population and external dataset, using comparable adaptation protocols and appropriate baselines.
这是一个对比学习方向的单项损失：j 是 i 的配对视图，其他视图参与分母，τ 调节分数尺度；完整训练会对多个方向取平均。
This is one directional contrastive loss term. j is the paired view for i; other views enter the denominator. τ controls score scale. Training averages terms over multiple directions.
设计一个公平的迁移比较
Design a fair transfer comparison
用相同患者划分、相同下游标注量和相同分类头，比较随机初始化、通用预训练与医学预训练。先统一冻结编码器做线性探测，再另设统一微调实验；分别报告，不把两种设置混成一张排名。

Compare random initialization, general-domain pretraining and medical pretraining using identical patient splits, downstream labels and classification heads. Run one frozen-encoder linear-probe experiment, then a separate experiment with a shared fine-tuning protocol. Report them as distinct settings.
“没有使用下游标签”不等于“没有见过测试图像”；预训练重叠仍会影响评估解释。
“No downstream labels used” does not mean “test images unseen.” Pretraining overlap still changes the interpretation of evaluation.
线性探测通常更新哪些参数？
Which parameters does linear probing usually update?

只更新所有注意力层
Only all attention layers
编码器和预测头全部更新
Both the encoder and prediction head
冻结编码器能把比较重点放在预训练表示本身；更新编码器属于微调设置。
Freezing the encoder focuses the comparison on its pretrained representation. Updating the encoder is a fine-tuning setting.

No. The original image is unknown during recovery; reverse inference needs a learned prior or measurement constraints.
一次封闭形式加噪，算清楚什么是“预测噪声”

两个数构成的合成干净信号。
A synthetic clean signal with two coordinates.
